items.content: I'm moving on from @Google. I had the privilege of helping build two businesses from zero: first across Search & Ads, then Gemini. Three years ago, OpenAI and Anthropic were in the lead. We built what it took to compete: the playbook for building AI models, the customer feedback flywheel, and the enterprise business. Gemini 3 was the moment those systems came together. To the Gemini team: we went from underdogs to competing at the frontier. Keep pushing. For now, I'm enjoying the emergent capab…
